visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Round Robin Scheduling
visualizerParams.description: Each process runs for at most one time quantum, then goes to the back of the line. Repeat until all are finished. Waiting time is finish time minus burst time.

tests.pattern: (?<![\s\S])\s*P1 finishes at 10, waits 5[ \t]*\r?\nP2 finishes at 9, waits 6[ \t]*\r?\nP3 finishes at 6, waits 4\s*(?![\s\S])
